references.text: Describes Israel's wandering in the wilderness for forty years as punishment for their rebellion, which was part of what God did to them in the wilderness.
The Lord's anger against Israel and their wandering in the wilderness for forty years until the entire generation that had done evil had passed away.
The Lord carried the people through the wilderness all the way to this place, as a father carries his son.
The Lord blessed Israel in everything they did and watched over them as they wandered through the great wilderness for forty years.
A reminder of the forty years when the Lord led Israel in the wilderness, tested them, and gave them manna to eat.
The Lord led Israel in the wilderness for forty years, and their clothes did not wear out.
The children of Israel ate manna for forty years until they came to the inhabited land.
Israel wandered in the wilderness for forty years until all the fighting men who had left Egypt were dead.
